# #159 Gate B v2 — selected-baseline WOR cross-N

Canonical settlement of the accepted outcome-unexposed Gate-A package.

Decision: **POSITIVE_REQUIRES_STRICT_INDEPENDENT_EV**.

The primary nominal M=64 surface and nominal M=32/128 sensitivity use deterministic Q-informed WOR without replacement. Actual draws and stake use `effective_M=min(nominal_M,3^N)`. Every selected identity gets effective_M distinct tickets at ¥2 each; the 21 FULL_SPACE_SATURATED nominal rows are the same allocation per identity/seed/effective_M, not duplicate WOR tickets. Tax is applied only per individual winning ticket reaching ¥10,000 gross, never by pooling issue or policy stakes.

## Interpretation

The N curve is descriptive. Matched N-versus-N7 deltas use common positive-stake issue support only; YEAR/FOLD/LOYO, issue bootstrap, overlap and largest-issue controls are included in the package. Any positive historical cells remain descriptive and require strict independent EV plus held-out/forward validation. No historical row authorizes purchase, production, betting or promotion.
